comments.text:
The Godfather of New Jack.
I’ll never forget the day how I was introduced to New Jack swing music thru Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas as an 11 year old kid (2004) now I’m 33. CSR 103.9 that is. When I heard Guy - Groove Me thru the game, I was in love with the beat, the drum, the rhythm, the fusion of Hip-Hop and R&B at the same time. Fast forward, I’ve studied a lots, lots of New jack swing songs to this day. 22 years, still love it! It has been my fav genre of music all time. I have over 2,000 NJS songs in my head lol. Thank you, Mr. Teddy Riley for creating that fusion of Hip-Hop and R&B! I’m keeping NJS alive in me!
